Use with caution / monitor

Amiodarone interacts with warfarin [amiodarone:drug_interactions:4], leading to a potentiation of the anticoagulant response that can result in serious or fatal bleeding [amiodarone:drug_interactions:5]. This occurs because amiodarone inhibits CYP enzymes (such as CYP2C9 and CYP3A4) [amiodarone:drug_interactions:0] which are responsible for metabolizing warfarin [warfarin:drug_interactions:2], thereby increasing warfarin exposure and INR levels [warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. Consequently, when these drugs are used together, the warfarin dose typically needs to be reduced and the INR monitored closely [amiodarone:drug_interactions:5].
